ValidationRule.description: Throws error when Topic Sub-Type includes "Other" and Topic Sub-Type (Other Specify) is blank, for all PHOCS Case record types
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCFoodRecall", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSComplaint", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSEvent", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSReportableIncident", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRequestsInquiries", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterAdvisories" ) && OR( INCLUDES(TopicSubtypeMulti__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(ComplaintTopicSubType__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(EventTopicSubType__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(IncidentTopicSubType__c, "Other") ) && ISBLANK(TopicSubTypeOtherSpecify__c)
